pages.observed: Five phone-aspect frames of an illustrated airport curb pickup scene: white car entering at left, phone map card with Ride requested, airport sign, suitcase and bench, skyline. A two-line caption appears from 0.6 s reading Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver. Lower third of frame is empty dark road.

Five frames 1.0 to 1.8 s at the airport curb. The white car moves rightward into the painted bay rectangle with a red brake lamp lit and stops near 1.6 s. Phone card still reads Ride requested, Finding a car. Caption unchanged throughout. Lower third of the frame remains empty dark road.

Exterior curb shot at 2.0 and 2.2 s with the car stopped, then a cut to the car interior at 2.4 s showing a steering wheel, small map screen and two empty front seats with the airport sign seen through the windshield. The phone card remains pasted at left over the cabin. Texas outline card appears top right. Caption unchanged.

Interior cabin view 3.0 to 3.8 s. The steering wheel turns by itself with its tan marker moving around the rim, seats empty, airport sign slides off the right of the windshield, Texas outline card finishes drawing. The phone card still says Ride requested, Finding a car, pasted over the cabin.

Interior cabin continues from 4.0 to 4.6 s with wheel turning, then at 4.8 s a cut to the curb: a large tilted phone reading Ride requested, Finding a car sits in the foreground, the white car is parked in the bay at right, an orange dot marks San Antonio on the Texas outline. Caption absent at 4.6 and 4.8 s.

Curb shot 5.0 to 5.8 s. Large foreground phone changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb as its map pin travels to the destination pin. White car sits parked in the bay partly hidden by the phone. Caption reads the airport included. Texas outline shows a pulsing dot. Bottom third remains empty road.

Curb shot with phone saying Arriving, At the curb held static from 6.0 to 6.6 s, caption the airport included only at 6.0 s. At 6.8 s hard cut to a wooden desk with a paper street map, three pins and a February calendar tab. Disclosure label still says Generic car with no brand mark though no car is shown.

Desk map scene 7.0 to 7.8 s. Paper street map sits on a wooden desk with a February calendar tab. Static for first 0.6 s then blue river and orange street lines draw in from 7.6 s. Caption reads The service began in February. No car pin is visible, only small circle pins.

Map on desk 8.0 to 8.8 s. Orange oval outline draws progressively around the central pins while blue river lines and orange road lines extend. Calendar tab reads February and does not move. Caption unchanged. Texas card gone after 8.0 s. Lower third is wood desk with no content.

9.0 to 9.8 s. Map enlarges to fill more frame, the February calendar page tilts and slides across the map and ends lower left, a black pen line begins tracing an outline at the upper left of the orange oval. Caption switches to in a limited area of sixty square miles. No sixty square miles tag is visible yet.

Map scene 10.0 to 10.8 s nearly static. Orange oval outline already complete, black angular line at its top extends only a few pixels, calendar page rests in lower left. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. No sixty square miles tag or number text is visible on the picture. Lower third is empty wood desk.

11.0 to 11.8 s. The black polygon outline closes around the pins, a pinned tag reading 60 square miles, Limited area drops in and settles at 11.4 s, the enclosed area fills grey. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. matches the tag. Last 0.4 s static.

Map held through 12.2 s, then hard cut to a brown flooded creek with a small white car floating mid-frame with reflection, rain streaks, live oaks and a skyline in the distance, limestone ledge at right. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek appears at 12.8 s. Car is small and far.

13.0 to 13.8 s same creek composition as before: small car low in brown water in mid-frame, nearly unchanged between samples, rain streaks only moving element. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. across 0.8 s. The car is not being swept at this point and its cabin interior is not discernible.

14.0 to 14.6 s unchanged wide creek shot with the small car sitting in the water. At 14.8 s a cut to a medium framing where the car is about twice as large with a visible wake line trailing at right and reflection beneath. Cabin windows read as dark with no occupants discernible. Caption unchanged.

Medium creek shot 15.0 to 15.8 s: car sits low in brown water, rocks slightly and drifts right with a wake at its nose and a reflection below. Seat shapes visible through the windows suggest empty cabin. Movement is slow and small, not a violent sweep. Caption unchanged.

Medium creek shot 16.0 to 16.8 s. The car moves left across the frame in the brown current with a pale wake line and spray at its front, mud line along its lower body, reflection below, seats appear empty. Motion is a steady lateral glide. Caption is present through 16.4 s and gone at 16.6 s.

Creek car slides off left through 17.2 s, then at 17.4 s a hard cut to a residential street with two low houses, a tree, green street signs, a white car on asphalt with brown water pooled only at the left half. Water is shallow relative to the wheels. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater appears from 17.6 s. Lower third is plain sidewalk.

18.0 to 18.8 s: floodwater visibly spreads right across the street and rises to the car's wheel arches, the car settles lower, reflection under it. Houses and signs unchanged. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. holds. Lower third is plain sidewalk.

19.0 to 19.6 s the stopped car in flood water blinks amber hazard lamps at both ends. At 19.8 s the framing jumps to a close shot with the car about three times larger, blurred background tree and houses, car windows show seat shapes. Caption holds.

Close shot 20.0 to 20.8 s of the stranded car with hazard lamps blinking, water at wheel arches, empty seats visible through windows, blurred suburban background. Only the lamp blink and tiny ripples change. Caption holds. Lower third is plain sidewalk.

Same close stranded-car shot 21.0 to 21.8 s. Only the amber hazard lamps blink. Caption present at 21.0 and 21.2 s and gone from 21.4 s. The shot has held about 2 s on this static composition with the lower third plain sidewalk.

Flood street shot holds at 22.0 s with no caption, then cut at 22.2 s to a tilted paper card headed Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall, with empty ruled lines and a pen at right, on a wooden desk against an olive wall. Card is cropped at right edge. Caption Waymo filed a software recall appears at 22.6 s. Fields have not yet been written in by 22.8 s. Large flat olive areas top and bottom.

23.0 to 23.8 s the recall card slides in and its fields type on: Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791 (the value 3,791 visibly overlaps the end of the label), and a Summary sentence about slowing then driving into standing water. Small type on the card is tiny at phone width. Caption Waymo filed a software recall holds. Large flat olive areas above and below.

24.0 to 24.6 s the recall card finishes typing Remedy, Interim remedy and Interim update rows. At 24.8 s a cut to a wider desk view with a smaller recall card and a dashed grid of about 80 empty car slots, four filled with tiny white car icons. Card text is very small. Caption advances to that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. The card already shows Remedy under development and the April 20th date well before the narration reaches them.

25.0 to 25.8 s a grid of 80 car icons fills row by row, completing near 25.6 s, while a hand holding a rubber stamp descends at the top right toward the small recall card. No counter tag with 3,791 is visible yet. Card text is tiny. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Lower third empty olive.

26.0 to 26.8 s a hand presses a rubber stamp on the card leaving an orange Software recall mark, a tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in at the card's left and settles, covering part of the card's left edge. Grid of 80 icons is full and static. Caption unchanged. Lower third empty olive.

27.0 to 27.8 s the composition does not change at all: tag, stamped card and full icon grid are frozen for the whole 0.8 s sampled. Caption present at 27.0 to 27.4 s, gone at 27.6 and 27.8 s. Lower third is flat olive with no content.

At 28.0 s desk with frozen icon grid and tag, then a cut at 28.2 s to a roadside scene where a white car drives in from the left along a dark lane, no water visible on the road yet. Disclosure now reads The recall wording, not a recorded event. A paper card quoting the recall sentence fades in at the upper left by 28.8 s. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, from 28.4 s. Word spacing in the card text is uneven. Grass fills the lower third.

29.0 to 29.8 s the car cruises on a dark road with lane dashes scrolling past, the recall sentence card sits at top, caption The recall says the software may let a car slow. No water, brake lamp flare or slowing is visible yet. Lower third is empty grass.

30.0 to 30.8 s the car's brake lamp lights and a grey standing-water patch drifts in from the right along the lane as the car stays near left of center. Recall sentence card remains at top. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow. Lower third plain grass.

31.0 to 31.4 s the car drifts slowly with a water patch at the right edge. At 31.6 s a cut to a large side view of the car with ripple lines at its wheels and the sentence card still at top. Caption advances to then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. at 31.8 s. Car hasn't entered the water yet.

32.0 to 32.8 s the close car stays fixed in frame, a grey water patch creeps in from the right and reaches the car's front by 32.8 s, and the word may in the sentence card lights amber at 32.8 s. Brake lamp is red. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. Lower third empty grass.

33.0 to 33.8 s the car rolls into the grey standing water. The pool covers the road under the front wheel, wake lines trail and spray appears at the front wheel by 33.8 s. The word may stays highlighted orange in the card. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. This is the film's signature performed turn and it reads clearly.

34.0 to 34.8 s the car keeps driving through standing water with wake lines, splash and a reflection under the body. The may highlight stays lit. Caption holds. Motion is continuous but small, the car itself remains fixed in the frame. Lower third empty grass.

35.0 to 35.4 s car still in water. At 35.6 s hard cut to a large recall record card on the desk with the Software recall stamp lying across the Recall type and Potential units rows, obscuring the 3,791 and Software values. Remedy row reads currently under development but is not yet highlighted at 35.8 s. Caption appears at 35.78 s. Lower portion is flat olive.

36.0 to 36.8 s the remedy row highlights in a tan band and a pen tip appears at the right edge at 36.8 s. The Software recall stamp still lies across the Recall type and Potential units rows, partly covering the 3,791 value. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. Lower third is empty olive.

37.0 to 37.4 s a hand with a pen points in from the right at the Interim remedy row, not the highlighted Remedy row. At 37.6 s the pen withdraws. At 37.8 s a hand with a rubber stamp descends over the card, which has grown slightly. The Remedy row stays tan highlighted. Caption holds.

38.0 to 38.8 s a forearm and stamp come down across the card and press an orange Under development mark onto the highlighted Remedy row at 38.6 s. The arm and stamp cover the Summary text and the Software recall stamp during descent. Caption holds. The stamp lands at about 38.6 s.

39.0 to 39.8 s the stamp lifts off and exits upward, leaving the orange Under development mark across the Remedy row, which partly obscures the Remedy text. Caption present to 39.2 s, gone from 39.4 s. By 39.6 s the card is static with nothing moving.

Cut at 40.0 s to a car depot with four tiny white cars in a row, an April calendar page and a Vehicle maps card hung on poles, skyline behind. Nothing moves for 0.8 s and no weather limits tag with a cloud and rain icon has appeared. Cars are small. Caption begins 40.4 s. Lower half is flat grey asphalt.

41.0 to 41.8 s a Weather limits tightened tag with a cloud-rain icon slides in from the left and settles beside the April calendar, high above the cars, which stay small and unchanged in the row. Tag text is small at phone width. Caption continues. Lower half is plain asphalt.

42.0 to 42.8 s no element moves. The Weather limits tag hangs on the wire, April page and Vehicle maps card are static, the four cars sit unchanged in their bays. The held frame lasts the whole 0.8 s sampled. Lower half is empty asphalt.

43.0 to 43.4 s no movement, then a slight reframing at 43.6 s that enlarges the scene by about ten percent. Caption changes to and every affected car had the update by April twentieth at 43.8 s. April page still shows a blank ruled card with no date number and the cars show no check marks yet. Lower half empty asphalt.

44.0 to 44.8 s the calendar flips to a big 20 under April with a brief flap animation, then rests. The four cars in the row still show no check marks. Weather limits tag static. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower half empty asphalt.

45.0 to 45.8 s the depot row stays unchanged until 45.4 s when empty circle badges begin appearing above the cars and turn into check marks left to right, two of four checked by 45.8 s. Calendar and weather tag static. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower half empty asphalt.

46.0 to 46.8 s the check badges complete across all four cars by 46.2 s and the Vehicle maps card gains an updated check. Scene is then static for about 0.6 s. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower half empty asphalt.

47.0 to 47.6 s the depot scene is fully static with no caption from 47.2 s. At 47.8 s a hard cut returns to the airport curb with the phone reading Arriving At the curb, the white car in the bay at right of frame, label reading A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. No caption yet at 47.8 s. Empty road fills the lower third.

48.0 to 48.8 s the car waits parked in the bay while the phone says Arriving, At the curb. At about 48.6 s its rear door starts swinging open showing a dark cabin, wider at 48.8 s. Caption So the airport ride is open, matches the picture. Lower third empty road.

49.0 to 49.8 s the rear door opens fully and the car stays parked in the bay, phone card unchanged. Caption So the airport ride is open, through 49.6 s, absent at 49.8 s. The door open state is small at phone size. Lower third empty road.

50.0 to 50.8 s a recomposed curb view shows the open-door car and a small recall card lying on the asphalt in front of it, card text tiny at phone width. Nothing moves in the 0.8 s sampled apart from caption arrival at 50.2 s. The recall card does not slide in during these samples, it already sits in place. Lower half dark empty road.

51.0 to 51.8 s the recall card enlarges and settles lower left in the foreground on the road while the open-door car and curb stay static behind it. The Remedy row reads The remedy is currently under development with the stamp. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy. This is the card sliding into the foreground. Lower third dark empty road.

52.0 to 52.8 s the composition is frozen: open-door car, curb, and the large recall card with the stamped remedy row all hold. Only the caption advances to as currently under development. at about 52.8 s. Lower third dark empty road.

53.0 to 53.8 s a split composition: the open-door car at the curb in the top half and the recall card with its highlighted Remedy row plus a small phone reading Arriving At the curb on a wooden desk in the bottom half. A thin underline draws under under development in the Remedy row. Caption as currently under development. Lower third empty wood.

54.0 to 54.8 s the split composition holds without any change. Caption present at 54.0 s only, gone from 54.2 s. Narration ends at 54.04 s per captions, so the final picture sits silent. Bottom third wood desk is empty.

55.0 to 55.8 s the same split composition holds unchanged with no caption and no motion. This is the last second before the credits and the held final frame is the open-door curb car over the stamped recall card.

56.0 to 56.8 s credits card fades up on a dark background with the Texas AI Docket wordmark, the URL texasaidocket.com, and the sources, illustration, map and music credit text at small size. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark. Credits text is small at phone width. Credits use hyphen separators.
57.0 to 57.8 s the credits card is fully static with identical content in all five samples. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark.
58.0 to 58.8 s the credits card is static in all five samples with no change. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark.
59.0 to 59.8 s the credits card is static in all five samples with no change. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark.
60.0 to 60.8 s the credits card is static in all five samples with no change. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark.

The final native frame at 60.967 s is the full credits card, static and unchanged from the preceding 5 s, with the empty dark lower 40 percent. Credits text is small. The film ends on the credits card.
